title: RADio – Rank-Aware Divergence Metrics to Measure Normative Diversity in News Recommendations
reasoning: The paper explicitly defines and operationalizes 'normative diversity' based on 'social science's interpretation of diversity,' 'news organization's norms and values,' and 'democratic theory.' It discusses four democratic models (Liberal, Participatory, Deliberative, Critical) to assess how news recommendations fulfill a democratic role in society, which falls under the scope of ethics and morals.
